chestifier.config.tt.largechests: Allow chests to have more than 54 entries
chestifier.config.tt.halfsize: Half button size unless mouse hovers over them
chestifier.config.tt.transparent: Make buttons transparent unless mouse hovers over them
chestifier.config.tt.highlight: Hex colors, 2 bytes each: transparency, red, green, blue
chestifier.config.tt.enablesearch: Enable the search box to find items by name
chestifier.config.tt.enablecolumnbuttons: Enable the arrows above and below chest/inventory
chestifier.config.tt.enablerowbuttons: Enable the arrows left of the chest/inventory
